checkpoint.changesSince2026-10-19: No slide changed. At the owner's request (20 October 2026) the speaker notes were removed from the slides: the script is kept as a separate PDF, presenter-guide/AUS-presenter-script.pdf, and is not linked from the slides. Only the picture, clip and IFU-illustration credits remain in the notes pane of the image slides. The script itself was rewritten for the day: per slide THIS SLIDE WANTS, ON THE SLIDE, SAY (unchanged 10 October text), EXAMPLE (one concrete fictional example of the ask), STUDIES ON THIS SLIDE: WHAT EACH ONE DOES HERE (every footer code with the source, what it is, and how it supports this slide, with its limit) and NEXT. Text in presentation/design/support.mjs; DECK_NOTES=1 with build.mjs puts the script back into the notes if ever wanted.
